scope: research-only exact-key causal execution evidence reconstruction for the frozen 251 actual-after-cost episodes

causal_rules.decision_cutoff: event or quote watermark must be <= decision_time
causal_rules.order_join: exact order_id and ORDER_ACCEPTED timestamp equal decision_time
price_precedence: ACTUAL OANDA fullPrice snapshot with timestamp <= decision_time from the exact transaction
RECONSTRUCTED_CAUSAL latest complete OANDA S5 bid/ask candle whose interval end <= decision_time
causal_rules.spread_baseline: median close ask-minus-bid over up to 12 prior complete OANDA S5 candles ending by decision_time; minimum 6 observations
causal_rules.pricing_freshness: latest completed causal S5 candle must end no more than 15 seconds before decision_time
causal_rules.overlapping_oanda_files: choose the shortest non-partial official OANDA S5 file containing the decision; ties resolve by lexical path and the selected file remains one source boundary
causal_rules.portfolio_reconstruction: ledger events strictly at or before decision_time; never use later close/fill information
causal_rules.observed_execution_boundary: post-decision fills, closes, realized financing, and exit quotes are evaluation-only and never fusion inputs
causal_rules.dukascopy_boundary: feature-only; never accepted as OANDA financial, fill, margin, or unwind truth

forbidden: derive decision evidence from realized outcome or future quotes
treat unavailable margin as zero or sufficient
invent evidence absent from raw ledger or receipt

strict_eligibility.pricing: bid and ask causally available from OANDA
strict_eligibility.fillability: causal top-of-book/depth evidence or a preregistered conservative bound
strict_eligibility.costs: causal slippage bound, fee evidence, and financing schedule or conservative bound
strict_eligibility.margin: decision-time available/used/rate and required-margin evidence; required margin alone is insufficient
strict_eligibility.exit_unwind: decision-time invalidation/exit policy plus executable unwind evidence
strict_eligibility.missing_rule: any required stage MISSING makes the episode strict-ineligible

comparison.cohort: same strict-eligible episode ids for ALL_TRADES, prior single statistical family, and frozen prior fusion
comparison.single: prior frozen statistical_ml decision, no refit
comparison.fusion: prior TRAIN-fixed FUSED_DECISION_V1 outputs with only the new evidence gate applied
comparison.selection_bias: report strict-eligible versus full cohort pair/side/time/net distributions diagnostically; never tune on validation outcomes

tests: exact 251 decision ids and one ledger row each
no future watermark in decision evidence
long buys at ask and shorts sell at bid when a causal quote exists
mid is descriptive only and never a fill
financing outcome is isolated from decision-time schedule evidence
dual-leg unwind missing is not inferred from single-leg close
financial metric oracle agrees with independent implementation
strict fusion never trades an ineligible episode
